    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    fours = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    sixes = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]

    fminc, fmaxc = min(c for r, c in fours), max(c for r, c in fours)

    sminc, smaxc = min(c for r, c in sixes), max(c for r, c in sixes)

        for r, c in fours:
            cc = axis2 - c
            if 0 <= cc < w:
                out[r][cc] = 4

    return out
